blocks.text: Podon mein growth (nashonuma) ka matlab hai size mein mustaqil (permanent) izafa, jo oonchai, chaurai aur wazan (mass) kisi bhi rukh mein ho sakta hai. Poda saari zindagi naye organs (aza), jaise shakhein, patte aur jarein, banata rehta hai. Us ke organs siron (tips) se barhte hain, magar poore jism mein growth ki raftar ek jaisi nahin hoti. Nichle (lower) podon mein poora jism barh sakta hai, lekin ooncha (higher) podon mein growth sirf kuch khaas jagahon tak mehdood hai jinhen growing points kehte hain. Yeh growing points cells ke groups hain jo lagataar taqseem (cell division) hote rehte hain; inhen meristems kehte hain.
Meristems ki qismein
Podon mein teen qism ke meristems hote hain: apical meristems, intercalary meristems aur lateral meristems (kitab yahan Fig. 7.13 likhti hai; is se murad Figure 8.12 hai).

Apical meristems jaron aur shoots (tane ke oopar wale hisse) ke siron par hote hain. Pode ke jism ko lamba karna in ka asal kaam hai. Yeh hamesha barhne wale hisse (perpetual growth zones) hain jo jaron aur tanon ke siron par cells ki tadaad barhate hain. Primary growth mein in ka aham kirdar hai.

Intercalary meristems sire (apex) se permanent tissues ke zariye alag hote hain. Yeh ghaas jaise bohat se podon mein internodes (do gaanthon ke darmiyan wala hissa) ki bunyad (base) par hote hain aur patte aur phool banane mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Yeh aarzi (temporary) hote hain.

Lateral meristems taqseem hone wale cells ke cylinders hain jo tane aur jar ke kinaron (peripheral regions) ke saath hote hain. Yeh tanon aur jaron ki motai (thickness) barhate hain. Yeh lakri wale (woody) podon mein hote hain aur secondary growth ke liye bohat zaroori hain. Lateral meristems ki do bari shaklein hain: vascular cambium aur cork cambium. Vascular cambium xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan hota hai aur secondary xylem aur secondary phloem banata hai. Cork cambium tanon aur jaron ki bahar wali teh mein banta hai. Yeh cork cells banata hai jo epidermis ki jagah le lete hain aur bahar ki hifazati chhaal (bark) banate hain.

blocks.alt: Ek naujawan pauda jis par lateral bud hai; teer shoot ke sire, tane aur jar ke sire se teen bare dabbon tak jate hain: shoot ka sira; tana khol kar Cork cambium aur Vascular cambium; aur jar ka sira jis mein shakh, Root hairs, Root apical meristem aur Root cap. Daen taraf shoot ke sire ka section (Leaf primordia, Lateral bud primordia; paimana 100 micrometre) aur jar ke sire ka section (Root apical meristem, Root cap; paimana 50 micrometre).
blocks.caption: Figure 8.12: Apical meristem pode ka primary jism aur lateral meristem secondary jism banata hai (kitab ki Figure 8.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Siron (tips) par apical meristems hain jo pode ko lamba karte hain: yeh primary plant body hai. Tane ke andar ke cambium (vascular aur cork) lateral meristems hain jo tane ko mota karte hain: yeh secondary plant body hai. Leaf primordia aur lateral bud primordia aage chal kar naye patte aur shakhein bante hain.
Growth ki qismein
Podon mein growth do qism ki hoti hai: primary growth aur secondary growth (kitab yahan Fig. 7.14 likhti hai; is se murad Figure 8.14 hai).
Primary growth

Primary growth se pode ki lambai barhti hai. Yeh apical meristems ke kaam se hoti hai. Herbaceous (narm tane wale) pode aam taur par primary growth dikhate hain aur woody podon ke muqable mein un mein secondary growth bohat kam hoti hai.
Podon mein primary growth teen marhalon (phases) mein hoti hai.

items: Cell division (taqseem): apical meristems ke cells taqseem hote hain aur cells ki tadaad barh jati hai. Yeh jar aur shoot ke apical meristems ke siron par hota hai. Apical meristem ka jo hissa cell division karta hai use zone of cell division kehte hain. Is zone mein cells chhote hote hain aur un mein vacuole nahin hota (non-vacuolated). In cells ke gol (spherical) nuclei cytoplasm ke beech mein hote hain.

Cell elongation (lamba hona): naye cells bante hi pani le kar apna hajm (volume) barhate hain. Cell wall ki lachak (plasticity) barh jati hai aur deewar ka dabao (wall pressure) kam ho jata hai. Yeh apical meristems ke siron se thora peeche hota hai. Jahan cells lambe hote hain use zone of cell elongation kehte hain. Is zone mein cells bare hote hain aur un mein vacuoles hote hain; un ke nuclei cytoplasm ke kinaron par hote hain. Is marhale mein mukhtalif cells mukhtalif simton mein lambe hote hain aur apna aakhri size le lete hain. Misal ke taur par jo cells pith ya cortex banenge woh lambai mein zyada nahin barhte, jab ke jo cells xylem tissue banenge woh lambai mein zyada barhte hain.

Cell differentiation (khaas kaam ke liye badalna): jab cells apna aakhri size aur shakal le lete hain to lamba hona ruk jata hai aur cells khaas kaamon ke liye makhsoos (specialized) ho jate hain. Un ki deewarein moti ho jati hain aur kai nayi banawati khasoosiyat paida hoti hain. Yeh zone of elongation ke saath wale hisse mein hota hai jise zone of cell differentiation kehte hain. Is zone mein cells poori tarah differentiate ho chuke hote hain aur har qism ka cell apna khaas kaam karta hai.

blocks.alt: Jar ke sire ka lambai mein section. Rangeen patti sire se upar ki taraf Zone of Division (neela), Zone of Elongation (hara) aur Zone of Differentiation (narangi) dikhati hai. Andar beech mein neela Xylem aur us ke pehlu mein Phloem, un ke gird Pericycle aur Endodermis, phir Cortex aur Epidermis; Root hairs sirf zone of differentiation mein. Sire par Apical meristem pyale-numa Root cap ke peeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.13: Jar mein primary growth (kitab ki Figure 8.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar parhein: sire ke paas cells taqseem hote hain (division), un ke oopar lambe hote hain (elongation), aur phir khaas tissues mein badal jate hain (differentiation). Root hairs isi aakhri zone mein nikalte hain. Root cap meristem ko mitti ki ragar se bachata hai.
Secondary growth

Secondary growth ka matlab hai tanon aur jaron ki motai ya gherai (girth) mein izafa. Yeh lateral meristems, yani vascular cambium aur cork cambium, ke kaam se hoti hai. Yeh woody perennial podon (kai saal zinda rehne wale lakri ke pode) mein zyada numayan hai, jab ke herbaceous pode sirf primary growth dikhate hain.

Vascular cambium ke cells taqseem ho kar apne bahar aur andar dono kinaron par naye cells banate hain. Bahar wale kinare par bane cells secondary phloem banate hain aur andar wale kinare par bane cells secondary xylem banate hain. Secondary tissues (khaas taur par secondary xylem) pode ki motai barhate hain. Cork cambium ki taqseem se bhi bahar aur andar dono taraf cells bante hain; yeh cells naya cork banate hain. Pake hue tane mein vascular cambium se bahar ka saara hissa, jis mein secondary phloem, cork cambium aur cork shamil hain, mil kar bark (chhaal) kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Ek pauda Shoot system aur Root system ke brackets ke saath: Shoot tip (shoot apical meristem aur naujawan patte), Axillary bud meristem, Lateral growth meristems aur Root apical meristems. Teer do tane ki tikiyon (discs) tak jate hain. Upar wali (Apical meristems increase height): Epidermis, Primary phloem, Primary xylem, Vascular cambium.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.14: Pode mein primary aur secondary growth (kitab ki Figure 8.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek pauda Shoot system aur Root system ke brackets ke saath: Shoot tip (shoot apical meristem aur naujawan patte), Axillary bud meristem, Lateral growth meristems aur Root apical meristems. Teer do tane ki tikiyon (discs) tak jate hain. Upar wali (Apical meristems increase height): Epidermis, Primary phloem, Primary xylem, Vascular cambium. Neeche wali chauri (Lateral meristems increase girth): Primary phloem, Secondary phloem, Vascular cambium, Primary xylem, Secondary xylem, aur bahar Cork cambium.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono tikiyon (discs) ka muqabla karein. Oopar wali mein sirf primary tissues hain. Neeche wali mein vascular cambium ne andar ki taraf secondary xylem aur bahar ki taraf secondary phloem banaya hai, is liye tana mota ho gaya; sab se bahar cork cambium cork bana kar chhaal (bark) banata hai.

Annual rings (salana halqe) darakhton mein cambium ki mausami (seasonal) sargarmi se bante hain. Is amal par mahol ke asrat parte hain, aur har saal do alag qism ki lakri banti hai: spring wood (bahar ki lakri, early wood) aur autumn wood (khizan ki lakri, late wood). Yeh rings darakht ki umar aur har growing season (barhne ke mausam) ke mahol ke halaat ke bare mein qeemti maloomat dete hain.

Cambium ek meristematic tissue hai jo naye vascular tissues, yani xylem aur phloem, banata hai. Bahar (spring) mein jab halaat achhe hote hain to cambium bohat tezi se kaam karta hai aur chaure vessels wala bohat sa xylem banata hai; is se halke rang ki spring wood banti hai. Jab mausam khizan (autumn) ki taraf jata hai to cambium ka kaam kam ho jata hai. Ab yeh kam xylem elements banata hai jo tang (narrow) aur ghane (dense) hote hain; is se gehre rang ki autumn wood banti hai. Spring wood aur autumn wood mil kar ek mukammal annual ring banate hain. Har saal ek naya ring jurta hai, is liye dendrochronology ke zariye darakht ki umar maloom ki ja sakti hai.

Dendrochronology woh scientific tareeqa hai jis mein darakht ke rings ka mutala kar ke un ki tareekh (date) maloom ki jati hai aur guzre hue zamane ke mausam (climate) aur waqiat ka andaza lagaya jata hai.

Spring se autumn ki taraf lakri ki tabdeeli aahista aahista (gradual) hoti hai, magar agle saal autumn se dobara spring ki taraf tabdeeli achanak (abrupt) hoti hai, is liye har saal ki growth ki hadd saaf nazar aati hai. Yeh maloomat lambe arse ke mausam (climate) ki tabdeeliyon ke mutale ke liye qeemti hai.

blocks.alt: Kata hua tana jis se ek tikona tukra nikala gaya hai. Upar ki transverse satah par beech mein pith, gehri heartwood, halki sapwood aur bohat se growth rings, gird inner bark aur kali outer bark. Nikale gaye tukre ki deewarein radial surface (seedhi lakeerein) aur saamne chhaal hata kar tangential surface (mure hue namoone). Labels: sapwood, heartwood, pith, growth rings, transverse surface, radial surface, inner bark, outer bark, tangential surface.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.15: Darakht ke tane ki banawat, annual rings ke saath (kitab ki Figure 8.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har saal cambium ek halka hissa (spring wood) aur ek gehra hissa (autumn wood) banata hai; dono mil kar ek annual ring hain, is liye rings gin kar darakht ki umar maloom hoti hai. Beech ki gehri heartwood purani aur sakht hai; bahar ki halki sapwood abhi pani le jati hai.
Plant growth regulators

Pode apne cells mein growth aur metabolism ki raftar ko khud control karte hain. Khaas chemical messengers (kimiyai paigham-rasan), jinhen plant growth regulators ya plant hormones kehte hain, un ki growth ko control karte hain. Plant growth regulators ke paanch bare groups hain: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid aur ethylene.
Auxins
Auxins indole acetic acid (IAA) ya us ki doosri shaklein hain. Yeh neeche diye gaye kaam control karte hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne naam “indole acetie acid” chhapa hai; sahi naam indole acetic acid (IAA) hai.

items: Tane mein sire (apex) ke peeche wale hisse mein cells ko bara karte hain (cell enlargement).
Cambium mein cell division barhate hain.

Jar mein bohat kam concentration par growth barhate hain, magar zyada concentration par growth rok dete hain, jaise geotropism mein. Cuttings (qalam) aur calluses (cells ka be-tarteeb dher) se jarein nikalne mein madad karte hain.
Shoots mein kaliyan (buds) shuru karne mein madad karte hain, magar kabhi kabhi cytokinins ke mukhalif (antagonistic) ho kar is ko rok bhi dete hain.
Apical dominance (oopar wali kali ka neeche wali kaliyon ko barhne na dena) aur phal ki growth barhate hain. Kabhi kabhi beej ke baghair phal (parthenocarpy) bhi paida kar dete hain.
Kuch qismon (species) mein patton ke burhape (senescence) ko der se lane mein madad karte hain.
Abscission (patton ya phalon ka toot kar girna) ko rokte hain.

blocks.text: Gibberellin

Gibberellins jaron aur shoots ke sire wale hisson mein bante hain aur wahan se pode ke doosre hisson tak jate hain. Gibberellins mein gibberellic acid shamil hai aur 110 se zyada mukhtalif gibberellins maloom hain. Yeh neeche diye gaye kaam karte hain:

items: Auxins ki maujoodgi mein cells ko bara karte hain. Apical meristem aur cambium mein cell division bhi barhate hain.
Kuch rosette podon (jin ke patte zameen ke qareeb gol daire mein hote hain) mein ‘bolting’ (tane ka achanak lamba ho jana) karwate hain.
Chrysanthemum callus ke shoots mein kaliyan shuru karwate hain.
Patton aur phalon ki growth barhate hain. Parthenocarpy bhi karwa sakte hain.
Apical dominance mein auxins ke asar ko barhate hain.
Kaliyon aur beejon ki dormancy (soye rehne ki halat) khatam karte hain.
Kabhi kabhi surkh (red) roshni ki jagah kaam kar sakte hain; is liye long-day podon mein phool laate hain aur short-day podon mein phool rokte hain.
Kuch qismon mein patton ke senescence ko der se laate hain.

blocks.text: Cytokinins

Cytokinins aam taur par jaron, naye phalon aur beejon mein bante hain. Yeh cell division ke dauran cytokinesis (cytoplasm ka do hisson mein batna) ko barhate hain. Yeh DNA replication ki raftar aur RNA aur protein banne ki raftar barhate hain. Yeh neeche diye gaye kaam karte hain:

items: Apical meristem aur cambium mein cell division se tane ki growth barhate hain.
Primary (asal) jar ki growth rokte hain.
Lateral (pehlu wali) jaron ki growth barhate hain.
Kaliyan shuru karne aur patton ki growth barhate hain.
Phal ki growth barhate hain magar bohat kam parthenocarpy karwate hain.
Lateral kaliyon ki growth barhate hain aur kaliyon ki dormancy bhi khatam karte hain.
Patton ke senescence ko der se laate hain.
Stomata ke khulne ko barhate hain.

blocks.text: Abscisic acid
Abscisic acid (ABA) zyada tar pake hue hare patton, phalon aur root caps mein banta hai. Yeh neeche diye gaye kaam karta hai:

items: Tane aur jar ki growth rokta hai, khaas taur par physiological stress (jaise sookha (drought) ya zameen mein pani khara ho jana (waterlogging)) ke dauran.
Kaliyon aur beejon ki dormancy barhata hai.
Short-day podon mein phool laata hai aur long-day podon mein phool rokta hai (gibberellins ka ulat).
Kabhi kabhi patton ka senescence barhata hai.
Abscission barhata hai.
Pani ki kami (murjhane, wilting) ki halat mein stomata band karwata hai.

blocks.text: Ethylene
Ethylene podon ke metabolism se qudrati taur par banne wali cheez hai. Yeh tane ki growth rokta hai, khaas taur par physiological stress ke dauran.

items: Jar ki growth rokta hai.
Kaliyon ki dormancy khatam karta hai.
Ananas (pineapple) mein phool laata hai.
Phal pakata hai (fruit ripening).

blocks.prompt: Ek maali (gardener) chahta hai ke (a) qalmein (cuttings) jarein pakar lein aur (b) kele jaldi pak jayen. Har kaam ke liye kaun sa growth regulator madad karega? Aur pode ka oopar wala sira (shoot tip) kaat dene se poda zyada ghana (bushy) kyun ho jata hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Auxin cuttings se jarein nikalne mein madad karta hai. (b) Ethylene phal pakata hai. Shoot tip ka auxin apical dominance qaim rakhta hai, yani neeche wali lateral kaliyon ko barhne nahin deta. Sira kaat dene se yeh rukawat khatam ho jati hai, aur cytokinins lateral kaliyon ki growth barha dete hain, is liye nayi shakhein nikal aati hain aur poda ghana ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Growth size mein mustaqil izafa hai jo meristems karte hain: apical (siron par; lambai, primary growth), intercalary (ghaas mein internodes ki base par; aarzi) aur lateral (vascular aur cork cambium; motai, secondary growth).

Primary growth ke teen zones: cell division, cell elongation aur cell differentiation. Secondary growth: vascular cambium bahar secondary phloem aur andar secondary xylem banata hai; cork cambium cork banata hai; secondary phloem, cork cambium aur cork mil kar bark hain.
Annual ring = halki spring wood + gehri autumn wood; rings gin kar umar aur purane mausam ka pata chalta hai (dendrochronology).
Paanch growth regulators: auxins (IAA), gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid aur ethylene; har ek growth, dormancy, phool, senescence, abscission, stomata ya phal pakne ko barhata ya rokta hai.
